_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Forty-fifth scheduled run. 16 of 22 URLs served and 10,392 product pages reviewed, a new high. NO NEW MATCHES against the chart anywhere, and every site with a feed answered on the first attempt. ERGONZI served cleanly for a second consecutive run after its resets of 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-11; neither cost any coverage.

THIS RUN FIRED 40 MINUTES LATE -- queued at 13:01:46 UTC, delivered at 13:41:35. The delay is in the trigger delivery, not in the workflow, and nothing about the run's coverage or its records is affected; the timestamps on this run are the real ones, 06:44 rather than the usual 06:05. Noted because a run that appears not to have happened at 6:00 is worth being able to explain later.

Your Roses grew 1,754 -> 1,759 products, Kate Roses 110 -> 113, Rose Explosion 1,471 -> 1,473 and Kisaki Plant 356 -> 357, with no addition matching a chart name.

Eight listings stand removed, each confirmed by HTTP 404: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001, HILLSIDERO-004, -005 and -007, SPRINGLAND-004. 450 of 463 cases verified present.

The five Commerce Farms cases were left untouched again: nothing here can re-verify an Etsy listing.

Screenshots 413 of 463, unchanged. Registered coverage 61 of 62. The 50 gaps are 44 High Garden (17 Pending, 27 carrying no enforceable right, all capturable by the user), 3 Flower Meadow Dream removed listings and 3 One Love walled ones.

Mola Rose and Muse Roses reported identical catalog sizes and identical match counts for the fourteenth consecutive run (789 / 48 each). Still flagged with the user, still not acted on.
